high_level_description: The image features a portrait of William Shakespeare, the renowned English playwright and poet. The portrait is a sepia-toned painting, giving it an aged and historical feel. Shakespeare is depicted with his characteristic curly hair and beard, wearing a dark suit with a white ruff collar, which was typical attire during the Elizabethan era. Below the portrait, there is a quote attributed to Richard II: "I wasted time, and now doth time waste me." This line is presented in a bold, black font, making it stand out against the lighter background.
